ordinary_review_finding.finding: The root CLI accepts a caller-selected --receipt path and writes the receipt with Path(args.receipt).write_text(...) after successful provisioning; the new no-follow/root-secure deployment rules do not bind that output path.
ordinary_review_finding.generated_reality: A root provisioner receipt is harmless observability output independent of effect authority.
ordinary_review_finding.counter_reality: Because the provisioner runs as root, an unconstrained receipt pathname is itself a privileged filesystem effect and can bypass the otherwise constrained destination topology.
ordinary_review_finding.strongest_counterhypothesis: Only a fully trusted root invoker can ever choose argv, making arbitrary receipt targeting unreachable in the production path.
ordinary_review_finding.discriminator: Machine-bind production invocation or constrain receipt emission; add deterministic controls for normal in-root output, outside-root output, symlink destination and pre-existing conflicting receipt.
ordinary_review_finding.recommended_repair: Prefer stdout-only receipt emission or a fixed/content-addressed root-owned non-writable receipt directory with no-follow/dirfd/atomic publication; reject arbitrary caller-selected receipt paths.
